sentences.en: How to deal with environmental pollution is a serious matter.
sentences.zh: 如何应对环境污染是一个严重的问题。

sentences.en: Most living creatures in the sea are affected by pollution.
sentences.zh: 大多数海洋生物都受到了污染的影响。

sentences.en: The factory is trying to get rid of water pollution.
sentences.zh: 那家工厂正试图解决水污染问题。
